ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio predominantly composed of low-intensity (black) pixels (~85-90%) with discrete, localized high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixel clusters and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity (black) contiguous mass across both lobes; distinct high-intensity (white) circular clusters at the distal tips; sparse, high-intensity linear streaks (scratches) distributed diagonally across the central-left and central-right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 45-degree angle of convergence and deep vertical penetration into the peduncle connection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-amplitude serrations observed along the inner trailing edges of both lobes; frequency increases towards the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly vertical upward trajectory with a convex curvature along the lateral margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity white pixel aggregates (barnacle colonies) located specifically along the leading edges and tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the dark ventral pigment of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (intraspecific scarring) across the ventral surface and heavy barnacle colonization on the leading edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Water droplet occlusion and high-intensity splash pixels at the base of the fluke where it meets the water line.
